mechanical.notes: 7/7 suites. Console clean across 3 states. FOUR findings, the first the most reusable: (1) A VACUOUS CHECK PASSED A DEAD LAMP. The emissive assertion was `emissiveIntensity > 0`, but three.js DEFAULTS emissiveIntensity to 1 while emissive COLOR defaults to black — so the check reported EVERY material as an emitter while none emitted anything, passing directly over the defect it existed for. The tell: it could not fail with any build. Generalisation (same form as the dead scene.environmentIntensity in r160): when a library gives a property a non-zero default and gates its effect on a SECOND property, asserting the DEFAULTED one is always vacuous — assert the one that ships OFF. Fixed to assert colour AND intensity in the material guard, the materials check, and the boot check. (2) The CONTACT-CONTRAST metric started as an ABSOLUTE luminance diff — wrong for a near-black interior: it flagged lens_barrel/lens_glass as indistinguishable at dL 0.011 (two blacks differing 2.3x) while it would have passed two whites 5% apart. Changed to WEBER contrast |La-Lb|/max(La,Lb) — the eye reads ratios; that pair now reads 65% separation. (3) progress.yaml shape-assertion: the `materials:` block landed twice in the wrong parent (outside passes:, then under gate_questions_resolved:) and YAML was happy both times (a map accepts any key; safe_load tests syntax, never structure) — now asserts expected keys are under the right parent AND no unexpected key appeared under the neighbour. Verified: all contact pairs >= 20% Weber, subject vs prop 40%; exactly one emitter (status_led #2fd07a) asserted by colour; 9/9 material contract parity; metalness near-binary (0.0/0.9 only), no metallic shortcut; framing 43/43 and lighting 1.715/0.094 unchanged; nothing floats.

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. Materials landed the dome's differentiation honestly: the near-black interior parts separate by REFLECTION (env intensity on the glass) rather than a metalness lie, the status LED finally emits, and the subject separates from its own white ceiling by darkening the SCENERY not the product. The standout is the vacuous-emissive-check find — a guard that could not fail because it asserted a property three.js defaults ON while the effect is gated by one that ships OFF, the same shape as the dead environmentIntensity — now fixed to assert the off-by-default property. The Weber-contrast switch and the progress.yaml shape-assertion are two more real instrument upgrades. Cleared to the surface pass.
